stories.title: From Dan Kendra to John Mateer, a investigation of jacked college QBs
stories.summary: Oklahoma's Mateer has turned heads this offseason with his massive arms. But has he gotten too big?

stories.title: Sources: Kushner, Iger to buy Lakers for $12.5B
stories.summary: The Lakers are being sold to businessmen Josh Kushner and Bob Iger for $12.5 billion, a record-breaking price, multiple sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Rory sure he'll keep PGA Tour status with 14 starts
stories.summary: Rory McIlroy said he's confident he'll reach a compromise with the PGA Tour to fulfill his minimum qualification of 15 events to maintain his dual membership.

stories.title: Rodgers on Lambeau return: 'Has to be an invite'
stories.summary: Aaron Rodgers says he had hoped the Steelers' preseason opener against the Packers would be played in Green Bay and discussed the possibility of a post-retirement return to be honored at Lambeau Field.

stories.title: Westbrook retires from NBA after 18 seasons
stories.summary: Russell Westbrook, who played 18 NBA seasons with seven teams, announced his retirement on Wednesday.
